# Introduction

## The reversal of educational difference

Women born just after the war were less likely than men of the same cohort to hold a degree. For every cohort since, the gap has narrowed and then turned the other way, in most European countries and in Austria too.

::: {#fig-tertiary-difference}
{{< include build/figures/tertiary_difference.qmd >}}
**The female educational advantage by cohort.**\
The measure and most of the design follow Erát[@erat2021], but the data include more countries (30) and survey rounds.\
